integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 3D animated, absurd-comedy tone, ancient Eastern-mythological era, bright warm palette of light green, bright white, and jet black with clean crisp edges and high saturation. An eye-level medium close shot at 00.00 focuses on a plate of snowy-white rice rolls on a light wood long table in the middle of a broad grassy clearing, the rolls glazed in thick sauce and topped with vivid green chopped scallions, flourishing trees and a pale cyan sky in the distance. The camera slowly pulls back and pans slightly left, revealing the bun-haired child in a cinnabar-red dudou with a gold ornamental collar grinning curiously at the food, and behind him the silver-blue-haired young man in a pale blue-gray long robe looking surprised. With a light prompt sound, the childish child (S1) asks: <d>[Chinese] “What is this thing?”</d> Before the words finish, the gaunt-faced man in black robes with dark silver fabric patterns leans sharply into frame from the right, upper body pitching forward, one index finger raised to point directly at the plate, and with a sly smile says in a low, flamboyant, mysterious tone: <d>[Chinese] “This is a rare snack. No one can say for sure what happens if you touch it.”</d> Forceful electronic drum beats crash in abruptly. [Shot 2] At 00:03.830, the shot hard cuts to a close-up with a tilted composition on the dark-robed man, his right hand hovering above the rice rolls with five fingers curved like hooks, the corners of his mouth lifting in a confident, boastful smile. Off-screen, the child (S1) follows up innocently yet somewhat nervously: <d>[Chinese] “Then what if you just touch it?”</d> Immediately after, with a harsh energy-burst sound, thick dark smoke violently surges upward from below and engulfs the man; when the black mist clears he stands transformed, wrapped in gloomy energy, eyes glowing dangerous red, both arms spread wide in an intensely oppressive pose, and he shouts in an almost arrogant tone: <d>[Chinese] “This snack is just strong strong strong!”</d> The electronic soundtrack pushes to its climax. [Shot 3] At 00:07.080, the camera cuts to a low-angle wide shot: three identical versions of the dark-robed man — the original body and two newly appeared phantoms — stand on the grass in neat symmetry, swinging their arms in perfect unison while huge ring-shaped spirals of pitch-black smoke coil around their bodies. The center duplicate clenches both fists and chants a lyric as if reciting a spell: <d>[Chinese] “Sindaro, Babulika la.”</d> [Shot 4] At 00:08.580, the shot hard cuts to a medium reaction shot with slight handheld shake: the bun-haired child and the silver-blue-haired young man on opposite sides of the frame simultaneously widen their eyes, mouths opening into round shapes, bodies instinctively shrinking backward in fear. With a dense rapid series of crackling sounds, a large number of milky-white liquid droplet particles suddenly pour down from the air and splash onto them, while the dark-robed phantoms in the background continue their exaggerated dancing, singing: <d>[Chinese] “Press over all of it, ya you la.”</d> The surging electronic music cuts off abruptly at the end.

overall_soundscape: A light prompt chime, then forceful electronic drum beats crash in and build through a harsh energy-burst and roaring rhythmic surges. Dense rapid crackling accompanies the falling droplet particles, with fabric and body movement from the synchronized dancing, before all sound energy snaps off abruptly.

non_diegetic_music: Beat-driven electronic music runs from beginning to end, with forceful drum beats entering in Shot 1, soaring to its climax during the smoke transformation in Shot 2, continuing to roar through Shot 3, and cutting off abruptly in Shot 4.
